name: Multi-pass GPU Ray-Casting with Early Ray Termination
aliases: Stream model for volume ray-casting on DirectX9-level graphics hardware
Stream programming model for volume ray-casting
definition: A multi-pass rendering approach that casts rays of sight through a volume for each fragment, using depth replace and early z-test to skip computations when an opacity threshold is reached or an iso-value is hit.
summary: Multi-pass GPU Ray-Casting with Early Ray Termination is a DirectX 9 volume rendering method that splits ray traversal into multiple passes to bypass single-pass performance bottlenecks and enable early ray termination.
